record.oneLiner: The largest known raptor, a heavy Early Cretaceous dromaeosaur.
record.description: Utahraptor was the largest known dromaeosaurid ('raptor'), a heavily built, ground-dwelling carnivore of Early Cretaceous Utah, about 6–7 m long and ~500 kg. Its feet bore an enlarged sickle-shaped killing claw.

notableFacts.text: The largest known member of the dromaeosaurid ('raptor') family.
Bore a large sickle-shaped killing claw on each foot.
